title: 第二章 刀枪剑戟
content_zh: 苏越刚走没多久，就另外有人来了。“表弟，你怎样了？”门外传来一个温文尔雅的声音，还带着些许忐忑，愧疚。“进来吧。”一个白衣青年推门而入，剑眉星目，眸清目正，身材颀长挺拔，脸上带着温煦的笑容，还有些许歉然和小心翼翼。原本应该是极英俊的，但现在脸上多了几道被鞭子抽的痕迹，嘴角又青又肿，眼角一片乌青，偶然露出来的手腕，也还有一道道被鞭子抽的痕迹。正是方彻的那位一掌干掉表弟的大表哥，方青云。看来被揍的不轻。一看到这个‘导致前身身死的罪魁祸首’，方彻就在心里下了一个定义。这特么……居然是个老实人！这种面相的人，就算坏，都坏不彻底，典型的忠厚老实脸，从骨子里透着一個字：憨。与刚走的苏越，正好是截然相反的两种人。方彻心中已经下了定义：这样的人当家主继承人，守成有余，开拓不足。也难怪啥都没察觉出来，就直接入了套。大表哥憨憨的搓搓手，对方彻道：“没事了吧？”方彻翻翻白眼道；“托您的福，还没死。”这句话，并非是刻意学着前身说话，而是脱口而出。说完才想起来最好要模仿前身的恶劣脾气，不能一下子改变太多，以免引起不必要的麻烦。但说完后想了想，蓦然感觉这句一下子就能噎死人的话应该比前身还像前身。不由心里一怔。听了这三个字，方青云更加的有些不好意思了，沉默了好久，才低沉声音说道：“方彻，我们是一家人！我不是故意的。”他的声音很诚恳，轻声，却沉重：“表弟，血脉相连，生死相关，荣辱与共，祸福同享！”“表弟，希望你原谅我这次无心之失。”方彻冷漠着脸，皮笑肉不动：“是的，所以你逮住我就往死里揍！一家人嘛，血浓于水嘛，我懂。血嘛，就是要打出来，再溶于水嘛，完美！”这就无法交流了！方青云面容都扭曲了。怎么跟这货就说不通人话呢？“这一次让我回来帮你打磨突破，是姑母要求的，也是爷爷，父亲和二叔五叔等长辈共同的意思。”方青云轻声道：“我们不会害你。”大表哥在拼命证明自己的清白。方彻沉默。我当然知道不是你干的，但原身貌似正在叛逆期，对整个世界都不服不忿，更加不将这个据说在武院同级排名倒数的大表哥看在眼里。在原身心里是极度不屑的：个学渣竟然……哼哼。据说武院同级学生七千五百人，大表哥综合比武排名在七千四百七十六。据说就这还保持得很艰难……呵，天才！家族资质最高？呵……——这向来是前身的真实想法。所以现在鸠占鹊巢的方彻绝不能假以辞色。于是他说：“呵……呵。”方青云有些期望的看着他的脸，希望听到他说句通情达理的话。却没有。只好自己说下去：“我知道你现在心里有想法，我过两天就要回武院了；我来这里只是想要告诉你一句话。”方彻面容冷峻，棺材板一样毫无表情，淡淡道：“放！”“……”方青云顿时噎了一口气，无力的叹口气，道：“不管你心里怎么想，也不管你想怎么做，但是就算要做什么，等你长大了，成家立业后，再去做。行么？到时候，我会全力帮助你！”稳住这小子，他现在还小，不懂事，等以后找了媳妇，有了家庭，懂了人事，自然而然也就懂得了。——这正是古今所有社会对不听话的孩子唯一的期望：长大了就好了！而对于方家来说，他们也坚信，这个孩子，能有真正幡然悔悟的一天。只是叛逆而已，哪有孩子不叛逆的？度过这段时间就好了。等以后懂事了，一切也还来得及！方彻自然理解的。所以他道：“嗯，我相信，到时候伱一定会全力的揍我的！”大表哥直接就忧郁了。若换成自己那几个弟弟，敢这么说话，方青云相信自己早已经拳打脚踢，让他们品尝来自大哥的权威，让他们有一个完整的少年时期。但对于这个敏感孤僻的表弟，却不能。他是姑姑唯一的孩子。“你说完了么？”方彻开始赶人了。大表哥，我以后再调教你。现在我刚重生过来要做太多事，你快回去上学去吧，当你的倒数第二十五去吧。“方彻！”方青云无力的叫了一声。“好吧……”方青云放下一个盒子，道：“这里面，白色瓶子是武徒级别的血气丹，黑色瓶子是武士级别的血气丹，可以帮你修炼……你记住，一定要突破武士之后稳定修炼七天后再……”“知道了知道了！”方彻冷笑：“小恩小惠的啧啧啧……这丹药没毒吧？”方青云深吸一口气，捏住差点就砸到表弟脸上的拳头。不行，我要忍住。一时间憋的脸色铁青。终于忍不住拂袖转身，走到门前，终究忍不住，重重的，语重心长道：“表弟！要努力，要懂事啊！”“大表哥！”方青云惊喜的回头。这是方彻近几年第一次叫表哥，方青云很期待的看着他：“恩？”“大表哥，如果排名武院是从后往前，你的名次还是挺靠前的。”方青云一张脸黑如锅底，捏紧了拳头。咯吱咯吱……但想一想老爹的鞭子，顿时又放开了手。恨恨看了方彻一眼。决定以后等他懂事了再揍他！大步而去。然后方彻坐在椅子上，在寻思自己的应对过程有没有破绽。然后他就陷入了深深的自我怀疑之中。我这张嘴……到底是咋了？他抬头，看着墙上刚挂好的【惜字如金】的匾额。嘴唇忍不住狠狠地抽了抽。老子好像明白前世为什么有这样的执念了。不过这次算是维持前身人设，以后决不能这样了。
content_en: Not long after Su Yue left, someone else came."Cousin, how are you?" A gentle voice came from outside the door, with a little anxiety and guilt."Come in." A young man in white pushed the door open and walked in. He had sharp eyebrows and clear eyes, a tall and tall figure, and a warm smile on his face, which was also a little apologetic and cautious.He was originally supposed to be extremely handsome, but now he has a few marks from being whipped on his face, the corners of his mouth are blue and swollen, the corners of his eyes are black and blue, and there are also marks from being whipped on his wrists that are accidentally exposed.It was Fang Che's eldest cousin who killed his cousin with one palm, Fang Qingyun.It looks like he was beaten badly.As soon as he saw this 'culprit that caused the death of his predecessor', Fang Che made a definition in his mind.What the hell...he is actually an honest person!Even if a person with this kind of face is bad, he is not completely bad. He has a typical loyal and honest face, and there is one word in his bones: stupid.Su Yue and Su Yue who just left are two completely opposite people.Fang Che has already made a definition in his mind: Such a person is the heir to the family head, who is more than conservative but not enough to develop.No wonder he fell into the trap without noticing anything.The eldest cousin rubbed his hands together and asked Fang Che, "Are you okay?" Fang Che rolled his eyes and said, "Thanks to you, I'm not dead yet." This sentence was not deliberately imitated by his predecessor, but blurted out.After saying this, I remembered that it was best to imitate the bad temper of my predecessor, and not change too much at once, so as not to cause unnecessary trouble.But after thinking about it after saying it, I suddenly felt that this sentence that can choke people to death should be more like its predecessor than its predecessor.I couldn't help but feel startled.After hearing these three words, Fang Qingyun felt even more embarrassed. After being silent for a long time, he said in a low voice: "Fang Che, we are a family! I didn't mean it." His voice was sincere, soft, but heavy: "Cousin, we are connected by blood, life and death, we share weal and woe, we share weal and woe.Enjoy!" "Cousin, I hope you can forgive me for this unintentional mistake." Fang Che said with a cold face, "Yes, so if you catch me, I will beat you to death!Blood is thicker than water, I understand.Blood has to be beaten out, and then it can be dissolved in water.It's perfect!"Fang Qingyun's face was distorted.Why can't I speak human language with this guy?"My aunt asked me to come back to help you break through this time, and it was also the intention of my grandfather, father, second and fifth uncles and other elders." Fang Qingyun said softly: "We will not harm you." The eldest cousin was desperately trying to prove his innocence.Fang Che was silent.Of course I know it wasn't you, but the original person seems to be in the rebellious stage and is dissatisfied with the whole world, let alone his eldest cousin who is said to be at the bottom of the martial arts academy.In the original mind, he was extremely disdainful: he was such a scumbag... hum.It is said that there are 7,500 students at the same level in the martial arts academy, and my eldest cousin's comprehensive martial arts ranking is 7,476.It is said that it is very difficult to maintain this... Ha, genius!The family has the highest qualifications?Ha...——This has always been the true thought of the predecessor.Therefore, Fang Che, who is occupying the magpie's nest now, must not pretend to be so.So he said: "Ha... ha." Fang Qingyun looked at his face expectantly, hoping to hear him say something reasonable.But no.I had no choice but to continue: "I know you have something on your mind now. I will return to the martial arts academy in two days; I just want to tell you something." Fang Che's face was stern, as expressionless as a coffin board, and he said calmly: "Let go!" "..." Fang Qingyun suddenly choked, sighed feebly, and said: "No matter whatIt doesn’t matter what you think in your heart, but no matter what you want to do, you can do it after you grow up and start a family.Then, I will try my best to help you!"Keep this kid in check, he is still young and not sensible. When he finds a wife, has a family, and understands people, he will naturally understand.——This is the only expectation that all societies in ancient and modern times have for disobedient children: they will be fine when they grow up!As for the Fang family, they also firmly believe that this child can truly repent one day.It’s just rebellion. How can a child not be rebellious?Just get through this time.When you become sensible in the future, it won’t be too late!Fang Che naturally understood.So he said: "Well, I believe that you will beat me with all your strength when the time comes!" The eldest cousin immediately became depressed.If it were his younger brothers who dared to speak like this, Fang Qingyun believed that he would have punched and kicked them long ago to let them taste the authority from his elder brother and let them have a complete teenage period.But not for this sensitive and withdrawn cousin.He is his aunt's only child."Are you done?" Fang Che started to chase people away.Big cousin, I will train you later.Now that I have just been reborn, I have too many things to do. You should go back to school and be your twenty-fifth from the bottom."Fang Che!" Fang Qingyun shouted weakly."Okay..." Fang Qingyun put down a box and said: "The white bottle here is a warrior-level blood pill, and the black bottle is a warrior-level blood pill, which can help you practice... Remember, you must break through the warrior level and practice stably for seven days before..." "I know, I know!" Fang Che sneered: "It's a small favor... This pill is not poisonous, right?" Fang Qingyun took a deep breath and pinched the fist that almost hit his cousin's face.No, I have to hold back.His face turned pale for a moment.Finally, he couldn't help but turned around and walked to the door. He couldn't help it anymore, and said seriously and sincerely: "Cousin! You have to work hard and be sensible!" "Big cousin!" Fang Qingyun turned around in surprise.This was the first time that Fang Che called his cousin in recent years. Fang Qingyun looked at him expectantly: "Huh?" "Cousin, if the martial arts academy is ranked from back to front, your ranking is still quite high." Fang Qingyun's face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, and he clenched his fists.Creaking, creaking... But thinking about my father's whip, I immediately let go of my hand.He glanced at Fang Che bitterly.Decide to beat him later when he becomes sensible!Stride away.Then Fang Che sat on the chair, wondering if there were any flaws in his response.Then he fell into deep self-doubt.What's wrong with my mouth?He raised his head and looked at the plaque that had just been hung on the wall.His lips couldn't help but twitch fiercely.I seem to understand why I had such obsession in my previous life.But this time it’s considered to be the same as before
